items.html: You find that these lights from the Chazeh and below come covered, and you already know that the concealment of the light and its covering is its correction. This is because by so doing, there is power in the vessel to tolerate the light, as it comes clothed. Hence, the breaking of the vessels from the Chazeh and below, which are the two bottom thirds of Tifferet and NHY and Malchut, is not like the breaking of the vessels of Daat and HG, and the upper third of Tifferet. This is because the breaking of the upper ones would certainly be greater than the breaking of the lower ones. Thus, when the correction of ZA came, during the correction of its Partzuf, it came the opposite. This is because its lights and the Hassadim were disclosed from the two thirds of Tifferet downward, since they have the ability to receive them not through the screen of Bina, since their breaking was not great. But the upper ones, which are from the Rosh of ZA to the Chazeh, came in a correction, and are now concealed and clothed inside the screen of Bina, which is her Yesod. This is because in the beginning, they were revealed and their breaking was great, and although NH are covered and concealed, it has been explained that the disclosed Hassadim strike them and their light comes out.
